assertion_assessments.description: One entry per assertion in the test code, judged individually. No overall verdict.

test_name.description: The test method the assertion lives in.

assertion.description: The assertion itself, quoted from the test code.

criterion.description: The part of the requirement this assertion is supposed to prove, quoted.

surviving_implementations.description: Concrete faulty implementations that would make this assertion pass. Empty means none could be constructed.

implementation.description: What the faulty implementation actually does, concretely.

killed_by.description: Another case in this batch that would catch it, if there is one; empty if it survives the whole batch.

verdict.description: bites = only genuinely correct implementations pass. suspect = an implementation doing nothing toward the requirement survives the whole batch, or the assertion cannot come out false at all. undetermined = no faulty implementation could be constructed either way.

assessment.description: Why the assertion does or does not constrain the requirement.

findings.description: Concrete problems. Empty is a valid and expected result for a good test batch.

what.description: What the problem actually is, in plain terms.

test_name.description: The test method this finding is about.

violated_criterion.description: The part of the requirement left unproven, quoted.

surviving_implementation.description: The faulty implementation that passes anyway, concretely — or, for a tautological assertion, why it can never come out false.

layer.description: plan = the plan stated the expected behaviour too weakly to derive a biting assertion; test-code = the plan named a checkable outcome the test failed to check.

evidence.description: The passage of the test code or plan this is based on.

solid.description: Assertions that clearly constrain a named part of the requirement, with the faulty implementations they kill.

unverifiable_without_codebase_access.description: Claims the test code makes about existing types/APIs/assets/behaviour that could not be checked from the package alone.
